mapper.select: select ifnull(experiment_code,0) from t_experiment_plan order by id desc limit 1;

select sum(case experiment_status when #{beSubmit} then 1 else 0 end) beSubmitNum, sum(case experiment_status when #{beAudit} then 1 else 0 end) beAuditNum, sum(case experiment_status when #{bePublish} then 1 else 0 end) bePublishNum, sum(case experiment_status when #{beEnd} then 1 else 0 end) beEndNum, sum(case experiment_status when #{end} then 1 else 0 end) endNum from t_experiment_plan WHERE is_deleted = 0

with experiment as (select count(*) experimentNumber from t_experiment_plan where is_deleted = 0 and experiment_status in (#{beEnd}, #{experimentEnd})), person as (select count(*) personNumber from t_groups_person where is_deleted = 0 and experiment_status = #{groupEnd}), researcher as (select count(*) researcherNumber from sys_user_role where is_deleted = 0 and role_id != 3) select experimentNumber, personNumber, researcherNumber from experiment, person, researcher
select b.experiment_status from t_groups a left join t_experiment_plan b on a.experiment_id = b.id where a.is_deleted = 0 and b.is_deleted = 0 and a.id = #{groupId}
SELECT id FROM t_experiment_plan WHERE experiment_status ='beEnd' OR experiment_status ='end'
select count(distinct a.id) from t_groups_person a join t_experiment_plan b on a.experiment_id = b.id and b.is_deleted = 0 where a.is_deleted = 0
select count(id) from t_experiment_plan where is_deleted = 0
